author: Para_Dice
body:
Map creators: Thund3rFangX206

 Helpers: Nobody

Monuments: 2 for each team (Left, Right)
Maximum players: 20 per team (40 maximum)
Items in order: Stone sword (1), Bow (Infinity), Diamond pickaxe (1), Golden apples (3), Spruce logs (32), Snow blocks (32), Cookies (48) Nebula shop (1). Leather cap, Leather tunic, Iron boots.
Gamemode: Adventure

Team names: Santas, Elves



Download: http://www.mediafire.com/?017r7yo8pwyp32q

 Images: http://www.youtube.com/watch?v=LXvteT9a7ak 


YAML: Inside the hats.

 This is for the Christmas map contest that SethSkye told me about. I hope I get accepted. Also, thanks to SweetMango for supplying the build server!
